verdict.rationale: Orama's GitHub README lists "Typo Tolerance" as a feature, alongside an "Exact Match" option that implies some control over strictness. The pack contains no documentation on how fuzzy matching works, whether it is on by default, or how to tune it. missing for 10: evidence that typo tolerance is enabled out of the box, documented tunable parameters (e.g., edit distance, prefix or minimum-length rules, per-field control), in-depth first-party docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
